limits: One generated example per shape, repeated identically to make equivalent bounded batches; not large or representative real Client documents.
Native parser plus one-source deterministic analysis; excludes source upload/scanning, database persistence and multi-source comparisons.
10ms whole-process RSS samples include worker threads; maxRSS is process high-water, not exclusive per-parser memory.
